title: An invoice made before the release shows the new text in the downloaded report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an invoice made before this release, invoice A, whose labor line, line 1, has a title, a description and a tech story.
  • Write down line 1's title, description and tech story, and invoice A's date.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to cover invoice A's date.
  3. Click Download.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range covers invoice A's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • In line 1's row (invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads line 1's title, " - ", its description, " - " and its tech story, exactly as written down: the new form, although invoice A was made before the release.
  • The cell has none of our field names: no "What are you doing?:", "Why are you doing it?:", "Title:", "Description:" or "Tech Story:", and no semicolon.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 16 (27 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-E4: “The downloadable Customer Invoice report is built each time it is downloaded, so an invoice made before the release shows the new text in it, while QuickBooks keeps the text that invoice was sent with (S3-N1).”
  • S3-R4: “The same text is used by the live QuickBooks sync and by the downloadable Customer Invoice report. Built at the same moment, the two never show different text for the same line, apart from the leading apostrophe the report adds in S3-R8a. An invoice already in QuickBooks keeps its old text there (S3-N1, S3-E4).”
  • S3-N2: “No line falls back to the old labels or the old questions, including lines created before this change.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
